name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for rental preparation repairs?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for rental preparation repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for rental preparation repairs begins with a free initial consultation and on-site assessment of your property. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, estimated timeline, and cost. Once approved, our team schedules and executes the repairs, keeping you informed throughout the project. We aim for efficient completion and a thorough final walkthrough to ensure all work meets our high standards and your satisfaction, preparing your property for its next tenant seamlessly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial assessment, detailed proposal, repair execution, and a final walkthrough to ensure quality and timely completion.
